auth_details: API key in the Authorization header for authenticated/write endpoints; public read endpoints require no authentication. Some MFA-protected operations also require an OTP header.
rate_limits: 10 requests/second for the API and website; 15 requests/second for the Dependency API. Additional endpoint-specific throttles apply to sensitive and write operations (e.g. gem push, yank, owners).
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor correct. Official docs document only Authorization: API_KEY (plus OTP header when MFA applies); no OAuth or query-param key for API calls.
